entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number to start?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Trail Helmet in Slate Gray, delivered on December 31st. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It's the color. The box is unopened, I just don't like it.
I see. No problem at all. Sometimes the shade can look a little different in person. Since you received the helmet just 6 days ago, you're well within our 90-day return policy for a full refund.

It's very simple. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. All you need to do is print that label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any postal service location.

Once our warehouse receives the helmet and confirms it's in new condition, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. We always want to ensure our customers are completely satisfied; proper safety gear is too important.
The email has just been sent. You should see it in your inbox within a few minutes. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and we hope we can get you into the right gear on your next order. Have a great day.
